name: Barista oat drink
identity: Foamable barista oat drink as cafés pour it (Oatly Barista Edition, Alpro Barista, the drugstore barista oats), 10 to 11 % oats with added oil, 50 to 61 kcal per 100 ml; the plain retail oat drink stays on BLS C660000 at 29 kcal.
rule: Per 100 g, each value is the median of the five labels below that declare it, and a value enters only when at least three labels declare it. The labels state their panel per 100 ml (Oatly per 100 g); the file takes 100 ml as 100 g, an oat drink's density being within 3 % of water, and the verified row carries the volume measure at 1.0 g per ml. Salt becomes sodium (salt in g × 400 = sodium in mg). Nothing a label leaves out becomes zero. Labels read on 2026-10-30 from the maker's page (Alpro) and dm.de and rossmann.de product pages.
